description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2540015412155 MIRROR ASSEMBLY,REA: Line 0001 Qty 131 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0053 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
